title: JazzCash Adds AJK Electricity Bill Payments
excerpt: JazzCash has introduced electricity bill payments for consumers of the Azad Jammu and Kashmir Electricity Department.
body_html:
JazzCash, a digital financial services provider in Pakistan, has added support for electricity bill payments from the Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) Electricity Department.

The integration aims to expand digital financial access and convenience for consumers in the region, allowing them to clear their electricity dues directly through the platform.
